about: IX3's fixture (SPEC-analytics.md § 15 item 3), invented: data points as Analytics Engine holds them, the columns the visitors query reads (day, blob2 the visit, blob12 the visitor since § 15, index1), in both layouts. Before § 15 (blob12 never written, read as ""): index1 is the visitor. After it: blob12 is the visitor and index1 each point's own random index. On 2026-10-26 visitor a1 is seen before only, b2 before and after (the same v, a second visit), c3 after only: three visitors, four visits. On 2026-10-27 visitor d4 writes three points of one visit: one visitor.
